other_conditions: Returned to Tamil Nadu on or after 01-01-2020 due to the Covid‑19 outbreak
Family annual income must be below ₹5 lakh
Applicant must not have defaulted in any bank or received assistance under other subsidy‑linked government schemes
Age relaxation up to 55 years for special categories (Women, Minorities, BC/MBC, SC/ST, Ex‑servicemen, Transgender, Differently abled)
benefits_summary: A subsidy of 25% of the project cost, up to ₹2.5 lakh, is provided to beneficiaries.
